caption:
The video captures a woman in a short, shiny silver dress and high-heeled sandals standing on a vast, mirror-like salt flat at dusk. A low mountain range sits on the horizon beneath a pale blue sky with a pink-orange glow on the left, and her reflection stretches across the wet surface. She holds a large, pale, glowing white sphere near her body, already in motion when the clip opens.

Over the excerpt the glowing sphere shifts position relative to the woman, beginning held out toward her right side at hip height and gradually drawn around toward the front of her torso. Her stance and upper body shift slightly with this movement, while her legs remain planted apart with one heel raised. The framing keeps her near the center and the horizon, mountains, and sky broadly steady, with only slight framing changes, while the sphere's size and brightness remain roughly constant, so the change is positional rather than an expansion.

The water reflection tracks the woman's pose and the sphere's position without showing separate moving objects.
relations: Sphere held at her right side at hip height moves gradually around toward the front of her torso.
As the sphere shifts her upper body and stance adjust slightly while legs stay planted apart with one heel raised.
The water reflection mirrors her pose and the sphere's position throughout, showing no separate moving objects.
Sphere size and brightness stay roughly constant so the visible change is positional relative to her body.
